The '''Kyyr system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] at the edge of [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]], between [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle Prime]] and [[Ota]]. Its [[Star/Legends|star]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], destroying the system and decimating the nearby [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route. In the supernova's wake was left a [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and a [[Thornhedge Pulsar|pulsar]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kyyr system was originally written in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' as [[Ryyk]] before being rewritten after [[Daniel Wallace]] realized Ryyk was located near [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>
